feedback.finish: Adulthood is the stage in life that comes after adolescence.

instruction.text: Select the brain to find out more about development in adulthood.

feedback.finish: Our brains keep developing into adulthood. We develop both emotionally and socially as we gain more experiences and know how to react better to new situations.

instruction.text: Which of these things are part of becoming emotionally mature?

atoms.b: As adults, people often have children and start a family. Many of the changes that happen during puberty, such as ((++producing_sperm_and_eggs growing_body_hair)), prepare you for this.
To have children, humans have to reproduce ((++sexually asexually)). This means that a ((++sperm teste)) from a man joins with an ((++egg ovary)) from a woman in a process called fertilisation.
The cells grow into a ((++foetus toddler)) inside the mother, and a baby is born after around nine months.

instruction.text: Can an adult do these things?

atoms.a: be more socially and emotionally mature
